english: Um... the designated place is\nthis classroom, right?
Summoning us with a note left behind...\nI wonder who it is?
Be careful, it could be a trap.
Nobody'd try to trap us\nwith such an obvious summons.
You're too easygoing, Koto.
Ah, someone's coming!
We're all here.
Ah, you're...!
You are...!
You know her?
We worked together once before.
You're Reki-san, right?\nYou saved me when I was in danger...
I was only fulfilling a contract.
You're the one who called us, Reki-chan?
Yes. In guarding Shirayuki-san,\nI've come to ask for your cooperation.
Cooperation?
The Academic Affairs Office requested I guard Shirayuki-san,\nand I'm currently on the mission, but\nsomeone seems to have infiltrated Butei High.
Someone... who?
Somebody called the demon sword Durandal?
Unknown.\nBut while continuing to watch Shirayuki-san,\nI sensed something off.
Something off?
Yes, the Shirayuki-san I'm guarding\nfeels like there are two of her.
Two? Isn't that just a mistake?
No, when I was observing from afar,\nshe moved a distance that was clearly unnatural.
Not like Shirayuki-chan ran at full speed\nor used psychic powers or something?
I don't think there was any reason\nfor her to do that.
A doppelganger...?
Like Remu-san said,\nsomeone who looks just like you appears...?
So there's a fake, you mean?
That's what I'd like you all to investigate.
As Shirayuki-san's guard,\nI can't make any conspicuous moves.
I see.
So, what should we do?
How about attaching one person near Shirayuki-san,\nand the rest search for the fake?
Kinda simple.\nBut easy to understand!
Got the plan.\nSo, who stays with Shirayuki?
I'll take that role!
Haruka, you can't fight.
The ones who'd fight are the fake-finding team.\nBesides, Shirayuki-chan is strong, so it's fine!\nShe can even call Red Angel!
I don't mind who takes it.
Then it's decided!
Fine, let's leave it to Haruka.
Thanks, everyone!\nI'll do my best!
We'll be moving separately,\nso we need a way to contact each other.
Communicators are already prepared.\nPlease use them.
Oooh! Well prepared!
As expected of Butei High.
Ahaha, Butei High has everything!
Haruka-san, please send Shirayuki-san\nan email from my phone.\nGoing suddenly would startle her.
Right. I'll email that\nI'll wait in front of Shirayuki-chan's dorm!
Don't be too desperate about it.\nShe might hate you for it.
Okay! Thanks, Houki-chan!
//Fade to black\n//BG: town (night)
Um... Shirayuki-chan's dorm is\naround here, I think...
Hm? Who's that over there!
Heeey, Shirayuki-chan!
You're late?\nI thought you'd already gone back to your room.
...Ah, yeah.
But I'm glad I ran into you here!\nI couldn't figure out where\nShirayuki-chan's dorm is... ehehe.
I see... follow me.
Okay!
(Good, looks like she doesn't hate me)
//Fade to black\n//BG: town (night)\n//BGM off, quiet
Hey, Shirayuki-chan...\nare we going the right way...?
Feels a bit far from Butei High, like...
We're going the right way.
To erase you... this place will do.
//Black Shirayuki attacks Haruka
Kyaa!? Shirayuki-chan...!?
Fufufu...
Why... would you do this?\nHuh!? No way!!
Noticing now is too late. Goodbye.
Hauu!!
//SE: attack sound and the clang of it being blocked
Good, I made it in time!
Shirayuki-chan!?
Two... Shirayuki-chans...?
I read the email.\nBut you never showed up in front of the dorm, so\nI came looking for you.
Haruka-san, leave this to me!\nYou...!
Okay, I'll call Red Angel!
//Battle map: only Shirayuki in initial allied deployment
Fighting my own form is\nnot pleasant, but\nI shall punish you!
//Battle begins.\n//Event occurs on turn 2: Red Angel appears.
Shirayuki-chan!!
Red Angel-san!\nIs Haruka-san safe?
Yeah, don't worry!\nI've contacted everyone too,\nso let's the two of us hold out until then!
Yes!
//Battle resumes. If a certain number of enemy small fry are defeated, an ally reinforcement event occurs.
Found you! I wondered where you'd gone!
Auuu, I was so worried!
Well, whatever! You're safe, after all!
It went differently than planned, but\nwe found the fake.
Intruder! Prepare yourself!
//Battle resumes. Event occurs when Black Shirayuki is defeated.
I won't forgive...
She got away...
No need to chase.\nWith this, she won't be able\nto enter Butei High again.
I hope so.
Combat over.
(Though I can't say the mission\nis complete)
//■After battle\n//BG: town at night
Everyone, are you all okay?
Haruka-san, it's good you didn't\nget dragged into it.
Thanks to Shirayuki-chan.
No, it's more like I dragged\neveryone into this.
But it's over now.
Do you really think so?
The Intelligence Division (Informa) probably\nmistook that girl for\nthe demon sword Durandal.
So I won't be attacked anymore.
So the demon sword Durandal\nwasn't here after all?
Yes. Thanks to Haruka-san, it's resolved.\nThank you.
But I just mistook the fake\nfor the real Shirayuki-chan\nand followed along...
A lucky accident, as they say.
Please rest well today.\nI'll report to Butei High myself.
Reki, something wrong?
No... I'll be going.
Let's head back too.
You're just hungry, aren't you?
How'd you know!?
Nobody's more transparent than you!
Then, let's disperse.\nSee you tomorrow.
Yeah, good night, Shirayuki-chan.
//BG: Butei High classroom
Still, what was that fake Shirayuki?\nI can't believe she was just some weirdo.
Remu-san was investigating an incident\nwhere doppelgangers appear —\ncould that be this...?
Maybe she's actually a long-lost sister!
I don't think so?\nShirayuki-chan never\nsaid anything like that.
Muuu! If she shows up again,\nI'll definitely catch her!
If I get a rematch chance,\nI'll interrogate her with the sawing-a-person-in-half trick!\nHmph.
//Fade to black\n//BG: black background
...Phew, had my bath, time to sleep.
//Email notification sound
Hm...? An email\nat this hour?
Um...
//END
